scope: Local only; no Chrome, production, external links or messages.
functionality: Independent optional work email, international WhatsApp and Teams sign-in address. No identity/recovery/HR fallback.
Explicit per-field private/company visibility and enabled/disabled state. Owner and current administrator edit; current eligible company members see only shared and enabled values.
Every shortcut click rechecks current server access and contact state, returns only a safe fixed-protocol destination; no automatic message.
User UUID identity distinguishes homonyms. Contact access is denied for inactive/deleted/suspended or vessel-restricted accounts.
Optimistic version and account-scoped SHA256 idempotency receipt. Retry returns current authorized state and never restores revoked sharing. Normalized no-op preserves version/audit.
Audit records actor, target, date and changed field names without historical contact values. Receipts store fingerprints, not values.
Contact editing keeps explicit draft in current tab by account/profile. Cancellation asks when changed; uncertain sends keep their operation and fields locked across temporary account changes.

Profile navigation scrolls/focuses local sections without changing profile route; current section is explicit. Existing biography submit now guards actor/session/route before and after async file read, before request and before applying response.

downgrade_protection.activation: Atomically on first successful contact save, including accepted normalized no-op. Validation, authorization or persistence failure rolls back marker. Databases never saved through contacts remain schema1.
downgrade_protection.compatibility: UI131 accepts recognition1/2. Actual UI130 ensure function rejects schema2 before access. Schema2 with missing contact tables fails closed and does not recreate them.
downgrade_protection.restore: Complete backup must preserve recognition marker and all contact tables. Selected transfer preserves marker2/schema, empties contact values/audit/receipts and keeps identities; UI131 opens it.
downgrade_protection.rollback: After contact save, code-only UI130 downgrade is blocked. Recover older version only with matching complete pre-contact backup and code; do not manually lower marker.
